dedupe_keys.name: eolien flottant zone d exclusion technique

description: Éolien flottant : zone d'exclusion technique is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geolittoral.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The technical exclusion zone for floating offshore wind corresponds to the interpolation of the wind, current and bathymetry criteria: Wind speed less than 7m/s AND Current speed greater than 2.5 m/s AND bathymetry greater than -40 metres AND less than -350 metres. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Floating wind: Technical Exclusion Zone" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include zone d'exclusion technique, éolien flottant, mer, EMR, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2011-10-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
